Subject: Vendor tax ID reconciliation and tele-verified signer confirmation

Hi Marie —

Thanks for completing the onboarding questionnaire earlier this week. Our procurement team ran a routine tax-ID parity check and found two issues that block PO issuance:

- The TIN on the W-9 you uploaded (ending in -472) doesn't match the DBA/registered name in the company registry we queried.
- The signer listed on the W-9 (Erik J.) is not listed as an authorized signatory in the notarized letter we received.

To move forward without delaying the purchase order, we can run a short telephone verification with your AP team to confirm the TIN and signer authority. This is an approved alternative for non-US entity paperwork per our procurement policy when documentary evidence is inconclusive.

Could you confirm availability for a 10–15 minute tele-verify window next week (Mon/Tue preferred) and attach the most recent W-9 PDF and a company registry extract showing the legal name? If you prefer, you can also re-upload a corrected W-9.

Attachment: vendor-tax-summary.csv (summary of check results)

Thanks —

Diego Fernandez
